editorial:
Imagine starting a journey to grow your family, only to find yourself trapped in a dangerous game. You follow Sundar and Geetha, a rich couple who are just trying to deal with fertility issues, while also keeping an eye on Selvi and Jeeva, a couple whose romance is hitting a rough patch. At first, these stories seem totally separate, but the movie slowly reveals that everyone is being pulled into a dark web of crime. It feels like a puzzle where the pieces don't fit until the very last second, keeping you on edge as you wonder why these strangers are connected.

The acting is solid and the way the plot twists keep you guessing is the best part. While the middle section slows down a bit, the payoff is worth the wait. If you love stories that make you question who to trust, you will really enjoy this one.
endingExplained: You find out that the undercover gang was manipulating both couples from the start. The fertility clinic was actually a front to scout rich targets like Sundar and Geetha. In the final scenes, the gang tries to blackmail them, but Selvi and Jeeva end up helping the couple fight back. The movie wraps up with a big showdown where the gang is exposed and arrested, showing that their plan for trauma backfired on them.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty crime stories and interlocking plotlines.
